title: Chickpea Pasta with Pumpkin Cream Sauce
ingredients: 3 1/2 cups pumpkin puree (approx. two 15 oz cans)
7 tbsp olive oil or plant butter (just under 1/2 cup)
1/2 tsp garlic powder (optional, to deepen savory garlic notes)
7/8 tsp red pepper flakes (optional, to taste)
1 1/6 cups grated vegan Parmesan (or approx. 1 1/4 cups nutritional yeast)
instructions: Boil the pasta and reserve water: Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil. Cook the chickpea pasta according to package directions, but remove it 1–2 minutes early so it stays al dente. Reserve 2 to 2 1/2 cups of starchy pasta water, then drain and set aside.

Sauté onion and garlic: Heat the plant butter or olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the minced garlic and red pepper flakes; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.

Build and spice the pumpkin sauce: Whisk in the pumpkin puree, vegetable broth, coconut milk, and all dried seasonings (rubbed sage, dried thyme, garlic powder, nutmeg, salt, black pepper). Bring to a low simmer for 4 to 5 minutes so the dried herbs hydrate and infuse into the warm sauce.

Emulsify and combine: Lower the heat to low and stir in the grated vegan Parmesan until completely melted. Add the cooked chickpea pasta directly to the sauce along with 1 cup of reserved pasta water.

Coat and serve: Toss continuously over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, splashing in additional reserved pasta water as needed, until the sauce turns glossy, rich, and clings smoothly to every piece of pasta.
notes: Estimated nutrition per serving (1 of 12) was calculated for the original version with heavy cream and Parmesan; not recalculated for coconut milk and vegan Parmesan. Servings, prep time and cook time are estimates.
